units: <cite ref="Chullin 111a:5">Ḥull. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>גַּאֲמוֹ לשבא</he> make (the son of) Sh’ba swallow it (Rashi). [Ar. reads <cite ref="C01006"><he>גַּמּוֹ</he></cite> (contr. Pa. of <he>געם</he> or <he>גאם</he>, cmp. Syriac <he>געם</he> P. Sm. 761 sq.) it made (the son of) Sh. feel nauseous (which was his reason for not eating it.]
